name: Depth Rendering with Variable Opacity
definition: A feature that enables Gaussian splatting backends to write a per-pixel depth buffer (NDC depth, +inf where there is no surface) which can be read via getGaussianSplattingDepth() to composite other geometry into the splat scene.
summary: Depth Rendering with Variable Opacity computes per-pixel depth based on actual alpha-weighted Gaussian contributions, unlike constant opacity methods that force uniform opacity for depth accumulation.
